comments.body: 2026-11-09: settled by the owner and being built tonight. His request: defaults by directory or repository, globally and by harness, a nudge from Muster asking an agent to compact itself, and an ad hoc per-session setting an agent can set for itself or its helpers; he answered yes to the nudge as a message, to compact_at still forcing later, and to building it tonight. Design, its tier-2 Codex review and pine's rulings: compact_nudge_at beside compact_at, [harness.<name>] and [[directory]] tables, most specific wins, muster pane compaction for per-pane overrides, a private @muster message once per crossing, only for harnesses with a compact command.

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
amterp, Chat Notes 2026-10-15: "in built compression warnings to the agents? or reminders". Clarified 2026-10-16: unsure whether agents should opt in, or whether a user setting should inject a message at a threshold asking the agent to compact itself.

Today `compact_at` (`docs/configuration.md`) types the harness's compact command at an idle agent's empty prompt once its context passes a threshold, so the agent has no say in what survives. A reminder would let it save its state, write a handoff, or run `muster pane compact` saying what to keep.

Open:

- Who sets it: a user setting beside `compact_at`, an agent opting in for itself, or both.
- How the reminder arrives: as a message from Muster, or typed like a ring (see a_2j17531rW).
- Once per crossing, as `compact_at` is.

An agent that compacts itself on the reminder then hits a_2izzbA9cT: nothing starts its next turn.
title: Should Muster remind an agent to compact itself as its context fills?
